title: The Power of Faithfulness
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares the powerful story of Elijah and Elisha, revealing the transformative power of faithfulness in our lives. Discover how a single-minded commitment to God's presence and plan can lead to remarkable rewards, and learn how to tap into the same spirit of determination and trust that propelled Elijah to his ultimate destiny. In this impactful sermon, Pastor Chris will show you how faithfulness can unlock a double portion of God's power and presence in your life.
